title: Overseer Wrank and the Captains
summary: Remove Overseer Wrank's protection by defeating his four captains.
overview: Remove Overseer Wrank's protection by defeating his four captains.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Complete the key turn-ins and prepare for the captain group before the overseer becomes vulnerable.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The controller begins with a protected Overseer Wrank.
The key counter must reach exactly twenty to summon Captain Nago, Lung, Lkai and Flang.
When all four captain-death signals arrive, the protected overseer is replaced by the combat version.

notes: Approval E377. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
The controller tests exactly twenty accumulated key credits; verify the upstream turn-in handling prevents overshooting that value.
